name: Kasturba Gandhi
role: Indian independence activist (1869-1944); wife of Mohandas Gandhi
summary: Kasturba Gandhi took part in the 1913 satyagraha in South Africa, the Rajkot protests of 1939 and the Quit India movement, and was jailed several times, dying in detention in 1944. Her own recorded statements are very few; most of what survives is a record of actions, so most positions are unknown.
